QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #2
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Moren's coworker Keol requested me to make a pair of shoes for his nephew. His pompous attitude is really hard to take, plus it seems like he's trying to just use me for things like this. I can't back down from someone like him! Fine, here's your pair of shoes!\n\n#i4001175# #t4001175# #b#c4001175# / 1
QuestInfo.2: Moren's coworker Keol requested me to make a pair of shoes for his nephew. Despite my best effort, Keol still doesn't seem to believe I am up to par with his standard of excellence...

0.0: It's you again. I can't trust your work, but Moren keeps recommendnig you, so what am I supposed to do? I have an order for you, but of course, if you don't think you can do it, you can just say no to it. It works out better for me anyway. So what do you think, do you want this?

yes.0: I have a nephew that lives out west in Ariant. Next month is her 9th birthday. The item I want you to make is a pair of #b#t4001175##k for her. I want nothing more than to make one myself, but I am currently working on a very important order from Carson, so I have no time. That's why I'm asking you to make one for me, since you're usually just spending time doing nothing.
yes.1: Making itself isn't hard, but I want you to put in your best effort. You know what I mean, right? If you do this right, then I may be open to giving more work to you. Good luck.

no.0: This is amazing. Our opinions actually matched.

1.0: Green? What is this, the 80's? I can't believe I entrusted you to design this. It looks so out of date, but it's my fault I even asked you to make this, so I'll let it pass. Your lack of skills is still very evident, but at least it looks reasonably like the item I asked you make, so...

yes.0: That's your fee. You're not asking me why it's not in cash, right? You're not good enough to receive money yet. That's because you're not on that level just yet. At least you finished this, so if I get another request, I will giv eyou a call.

item.0: Did you read the purchase order I gave you? Seriously when do you plan on starting? My nephew's birthday is coming up, and you are aware that I asked you to make #b#t4001175##k, right?

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
